Name: Indonesian Language Mod
Author: dragonregure
Description:
This mod translate your game language to Indonesian language. Support latest game version (current: 1.5.2)
This mod is 90% completed.

Manual Installation Guide:
    Make sure you've already installed Content Patcher!
    Download and extract the mod
    Copy extracted folder to gamedirectory/Mods/
    DONE!

Change log:
V.1.5.0  : Change the whole code so the mod will keep run smoothly on latest version and upcoming updates! Fully FORWARD AND BACKWARD COMPATIBILITY for PC and Android(Need QA)!
V.1.5.1 : Much more translated content
V.1.5.2 : 99% translated content
